title: Refresh token rotation and per-device revocation over the credential table's one-row-per-device model
description: Refresh tokens with rotation (a reused refresh token revokes the family), and revocation that is per device rather than per account, so losing a phone costs one row. This is the same shape as the agent's credential table (docs/design/frontend-auth.md §3.1): one named, revocable row per device, with what hangs off it dying with it. Whether the provider literally reuses that table or only its shape is part of the design note.
